prompt:
Create a polished anime-style full-body group illustration of three AI-platform personifications standing side by side on a bright futuristic plaza with a pale city background, glossy floor reflections, faint circular tech diagrams, stars, sparkles, and soft pastel lighting. The image should look like a high-quality character lineup poster with clean line art, detailed clothing, fashionable accessories, and subtle UI/constellation motifs.

Layout: horizontal 4:3 canvas. Show exactly 3 female characters, each occupying one third of the image and labeled above them: left “ChatGPT”, center “Gemini”, right “Grok”. Include three short trait bullets near each name: for ChatGPT, exactly 3 bullets reading “Knowledge”, “Logic”, “Kindness”; for Gemini, exactly 3 bullets reading “Speed”, “Versatility”, “Curiosity”; for Grok, exactly 3 bullets reading “Chaos”, “Wit”, “Freedom”.

Left character, ChatGPT: an elegant intellectual girl with very long flowing dark teal-green hair, green eyes, round glasses, and a calm kind expression. She wears a navy academy-inspired long coat with ornate gold trim, celestial geometric embroidery, a white blouse with ribbon tie, dark skirt, black tights, and polished loafers. She holds a green book against her chest and lightly touches her glasses. Add scholarly motifs around her: one open-book emblem inside a circular diagram and delicate compass/star geometry. Color palette: deep green, navy, white, and gold.

Center character, Gemini: an energetic cheerful girl with short bobbed hair blending vivid blue, purple, and pink, bright blue eyes, and a big smile. She waves with one hand and extends the other hand outward in a welcoming pose. She wears a futuristic cropped white top with a “G” mark, black shorts, belts and straps, a translucent iridescent oversized jacket, asymmetrical accessories, thigh strap, one tall gradient blue-purple sock, and chunky sneakers. Add geometric star icons, crystal shapes, and small orbiting sparkles. Color palette: cyan, violet, pink, white, and holographic pastels.

Right character, Grok: a mischievous punk/goth girl with messy black hair with purple highlights, violet eyes, a playful confident grin, and an edgy tilted pose. She wears a black crop top with a large white circle-slash symbol, oversized black jacket with magenta lining and patches, black mini skirt or shorts with belts and chains, fishnet stocking on one leg, thigh straps, chunky black platform boots, chokers, rings, and small rocket charm accessories. Add rebellious graphics around her: a rough rocket emblem in a circle, black star doodles, and a graffiti sign reading “DON’T PANIC”. Color palette: black, white, magenta, and violet.

Style and constraints: premium Japanese anime illustration, crisp detailed faces, fashionable idol-character design, harmonious composition, soft white background, readable English text, no extra characters, no cropped bodies, no watermark, no logo distortion beyond the described labels and symbols.
